what: At the interval set by the photo cell (default 4s), it flips half a turn on the Y axis in 1s ease-out, an accent-color plate (.8) covers it, and the speech bubbles and hand drawings hidden on the back rise in the same 1s. At the next interval it returns the same way — a device that turns a few flowing photo collage pieces into ”I like this kind of life” cards and back.

options.every: Flip interval (s), default 4 — the original uses 4·9·10 per group
options.delay: Extra wait before the first flip (sec), default 0
options.tint: Panel opacity when flipped (0~1), default .8 — the panel color is --fx-tint in style (default --kf-accent)
options.[data-fx-part=back]: Children to place on the back (speech bubbles, hand drawings) — several allowed. The user positions them with position: absolute

use: I like spaces like this

from.where: index.html .h-card.flip1·flip2·flip3 (hero photo collage) — original #hero_slide .img_wrap.active swapped for setInterval 9000·4000·10000

note: Cells given the same every flip together (if they attach at the same time). Cells cloned inside a flowing band (Splide loop) carry data-fx along and flip together too
